citations.title: Stochastic Price Dynamics in Response to Order Flow Imbalance: Evidence from CSI 300 Index Futures

entry_idea: Enter only when liquidity imbalance supports the direction and spread is below cap.
exit_idea: Exit when imbalance fades, spread expands, or adverse selection risk rises.
risk_idea: Reduce size when spread, slippage, or permanent impact proxy rises.
